Subject: AWS Marketplace SaaS metering & entitlement integration - Acme Analytics

Hi Jenny / Marketplace team,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the Marketplace metering + fulfillment conversation for Acme Analytics. They're ready to list a SaaS offering and we need to confirm seller-side steps for:

- Entitlement mapping (per-seat vs. per-feature SKUs)
- Metering (metering dimensions and recommended lambda flow)
- Contract / SaaS contract attachment and fulfillment type (SaaS Contracts, Private Offers)

Acme's procurement contact is on copy (we'll follow up). Can you confirm the required metadata and any sample artifacts (entitlement matrix template, SaaS contract language) we should provide? Also: is the AWS Fulfillment Provider path required for their billing setup or can we use the metering-only flow?

Next steps we'd like to align on this week:
1) Standard entitlement matrix template from AWS
2) Any redlines we should expect in the SaaS contract
3) Recommended SKU strategy for per-user + add-on features

Thanks — Marcus will handle the technical side and Monica will coordinate procurement and contracts.

Best,
Rafael
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
(attachment: none in this first message)

From: Jenny Park <jenny.park@amazon.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2025-07-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace SaaS metering & entitlement integration - Acme Analytics

Hi Rafael,

Great to connect. Quick answers and next artifacts: 

- Entitlement template: attached is our quickstart guide and a simple entitlement matrix sample (aws_quickstart_doc.pdf). Use one SKU per billed dimension — common patterns are per-seat + per-API-call add-on.
- Metering: for SaaS metering we recommend the metering lambda approach (metering daemon or AWS Metering Lambda). You'll need a seller-id and to register usage dimensions in Marketplace.
- Fulfillment: For SaaS SaaS Contracts, you can use AWS-managed fulfillment or use an external fulfillment provider. For Acme we typically recommend AWS-managed SaaS Contracts unless they require a Private Offer.

I attached the quickstart (aws_quickstart_doc.pdf) and I'll request a template entitlement matrix via a follow-up link if you want the CSV.

Doc actions: can you provide the latest draft of your SaaS contract and the proposed SKU list? If you can drop the entitlement matrix (simple CSV) we can validate mapping on our side.

Jenny Park
Partner Solutions
AWS Marketplace
(attachment: aws_quickstart_doc.pdf)

Forwarding Jenny's note. Marcus / Monica — please take these actions: 

- Marcus: prepare an entitlement_matrix.xlsx with proposed SKUs (core seats, pro-feature add-ons, volume discounts) and confirm which usage dimensions we'll push to metering lambda. Include whether we plan to emit aggregated usage or per-customer granular events.
- Monica: prepare SAAS_CONTRACT_v2.pdf (attached) with our standard Marketplace-friendly clause set; flag any language that might conflict with Private Offer or AWS-managed billing. Let's try to avoid language that prevents AWS from performing fulfillment.

Timeline: can we have the entitlement matrix + updated contract by tomorrow EOD? I want to maintain momentum with Acme's procurement. 

Thanks,
Rafael

Thanks Rafael — attaching entitlement_matrix.xlsx (draft) and notes.

Tech checklist / questions:
- SKUs: I made 3 SKUs: core_seat_monthly, pro_feature_calls, storage_gb. Do we want per-seat or per-seat-tier?
- Metering granularity: AWS metering lambda supports emitting usage for a given SellerId + Dimension. We'll emit per-account aggregated usage every 24h (reconciled). Any need for real-time billing?
- Authentication: we'll sign the metering calls with the seller registration token. Need the seller-id from Jenny to register dimensions.
- Testing: can Jenny provide a staging endpoint for us to validate sample events?

Attachments: entitlement_matrix.xlsx (columns: sku, dimension_type, unit, price_usd, description)

Action items for me: finalize the Lambda scaffolding, add retry/backoff per AWS guidelines, and validate idempotency.

- Marcus
